titulo: Guardiões e canções de Lórien e os Magos Azuis
nota_versoes: A correspondência individual entre Alatar e Pallando e os dois nomes do texto tardio permanece em aberto. A Segunda Era orienta somente a cena dos retratos inspirada pela versão tardia e pela série.

documentado: Elfa silvestre de Lórien. A canção de Legolas evoca luz nos cabelos de Nimrodel, pés claros e um manto branco.
inferido: A cor do cabelo, os traços, o bordado e o cenário são interpretação da canção. Nenhum rosto de adaptação foi identificado.

fontes.local: Parte II, cap. 4, Amroth e Nimrodel

personagens.prompt: Chest-up realistic portrait of an adult woodland elf woman living in ancient Lothlorien, by the cold shallow brook that bears her name. Long loose dark honey gold hair catching individual warm pinpoints of sun through branches. Clear strong gentle face with finely tapered elf ears discreetly visible, natural weathered skin and firm expression, white undyed woven cloak gathered at the shoulder, simple underdress of moss green linen, no crown and no jewels. Out-of-focus rocky stream and speckled silver-gray woodland behind her, soft cool afternoon shade and warm golden rim light, focus on eyes, understated documentary portrait with a 70mm lens, natural colors. Square composition, no lettering.

documentado: Guardião de Lothlórien na passagem da Sociedade do Anel.
inferido: A fisionomia e o cabelo vêm de Craig Parker caracterizado por Peter Jackson. O figurino e o bosque são interpretação. A batalha do Forte da Trombeta pertence à trajetória cinematográfica de Haldir.

fontes.local: Craig Parker como Haldir, no Forte da Trombeta

personagens.prompt: Reframe the young, clean-shaven elf from the supplied live-action still. Preserve the same youthful face of Craig Parker as Haldir: full smooth cheeks, true facial proportions, straight nose, small firm rounded mouth, slightly hooded alert light eyes, smooth brow, long pale straight fair hair pulled back at the temples. Only change his costume and location: a simple gray-green wool woodland cloak with a modest leather fastening in soft dappled woods of Lothlorien; one longbow peeks behind his far shoulder. Chest-up, natural diffuse light, real skin, squared photographic frame. Keep the reference age of around 30 and the same clean face. No lettering.

referencia.cena: As Duas Torres (2002), Craig Parker no Forte da Trombeta. O recorte prioriza a fisionomia.

personagens.prompt: Realistic square environmental half-body portrait, camera close behind a single elderly wandering wizard in the mountains of eastern Middle-earth. One solitary standing man seen exactly from behind, the face entirely out of view, long loose muted silver hair on the back of a heavy sea-blue wool travelling cloak with a simple hood folded down and modest hand-sewn edges. Straight rough wooden staff held beside him, facing a mist-filled river valley set into distant grassy hills. Soft golden light from the horizon, dark blues preserved in cloth folds, restrained pre-industrial shapes.
